http.401.sessionExpired: Run `opencode auth login` and pick OpenCode Zen to refresh your API key.

dataSources.label: Local
dataSources.summary: Adds up OpenCode Go spend from opencode's own database

args: WITH rows AS ( SELECT CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(data, '$.time.created'), time_created) AS INTEGER) AS t, CAST(json_extract(data, '$.cost') AS REAL) AS cost FROM message WHERE json_valid(data) AND json_extract(data, '$.providerID') = 'opencode-go' AND json_extract(data, '$.role') = 'assistant' AND json_type(data, '$.cost') IN ('integer', 'real') ), clock AS ( SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS now_ms, CAST(strftime('%s', date('now', '-6 days', 'weekday 1')) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS week_ms ), anchor AS ( SELECT MIN(t) AS ms, CAST(strftime('%d', MIN(t) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) AS day, strftime('%H:%M:%S', MIN(t) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS at FROM rows ), months AS ( SELECT ms, day, at, date('now', 'start of month', '-1 month') AS m0, date('now', 'start of month') AS m1, date('now', 'start of month', '+1 month') AS m2 FROM anchor WHERE ms IS NOT NULL ), starts AS ( SELECT datetime(date(m0, '+' || (MIN(day, CAST(strftime('%d', date(m0, '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER)) - 1) || ' days') || ' ' || at) AS s0, datetime(date(m1, '+' || (MIN(day, CAST(strftime('%d', date(m1, '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER)) - 1) || ' days') || ' ' || at) AS s1, datetime(date(m2, '+' || (MIN(day, CAST(strftime('%d', date(m2, '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER)) - 1) || ' days') || ' ' || at) AS s2 FROM months ), month AS ( SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', CASE WHEN s1 <= datetime('now') THEN s1 ELSE s0 END) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS start_ms, CAST(strftime('%s', CASE WHEN s1 <= datetime('now') THEN s2 ELSE s1 END) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS end_ms FROM starts ) SELECT (SELECT now_ms FROM clock) AS now_ms, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) FROM rows, clock WHERE t >= now_ms - 18000000) AS five_hour_cost, (SELECT MIN(t) FROM rows, clock WHERE t >= now_ms - 18000000) AS five_hour_oldest_ms, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) FROM rows, clock WHERE t >= week_ms) AS weekly_cost, (SELECT week_ms + 604800000 FROM clock) AS week_end_ms, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) FROM rows, month WHERE t >= start_ms AND t < end_ms) AS monthly_cost, (SELECT start_ms FROM month) AS month_start_ms, (SELECT end_ms FROM month) AS month_end_ms
